NOT_FOUND: We couldn’t find that. It may have been removed.
VALIDATION_FAILED: Some details look wrong. Please check and try again.
UNSAFE_INPUT: Some details look wrong. Please check and try again.
INVALID_JSON: Something went wrong sending your request. Please try again.
PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE: That is too large to send. Please try something smaller.
UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE: Something went wrong sending your request. Please try again.
UPLOAD_INVALID: We could not read that file. Please choose one file and try again.
INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again in a moment.
RATE_LIMITED: Too many tries. Please wait a little and try again.
SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: The service is busy right now. Please try again in a moment.
DEVICE_AUTH_REQUIRED: Please close and reopen the app, then try again.
FORBIDDEN: You don’t have permission to do this.
STEP_UP_REQUIRED: Please confirm with your screen lock to continue.
PASSKEY_FAILED: Sign-in didn’t work. Please try again with your screen lock.
INVITE_INVALID: This invite link has expired or was already used. Please ask for a new one.
MASJID_NOT_FOUND: We couldn’t find this masjid. Please check the code and try again.
FOLLOW_LIMIT_REACHED: You already follow the most masjids allowed. Unfollow one to add another.
ADMIN_LIMIT_REACHED: This masjid already has the most admins allowed.
ALREADY_MEMBER: This person is already an admin of this masjid.
NOT_MEMBER: This person is not an admin of this masjid.
INVALID_TRANSITION: This change isn’t possible right now.
ACTIVATION_REQUIREMENTS: This masjid needs an active admin who has accepted the undertaking before it can go live.
UNDERTAKING_REQUIRED: Please read and accept the admin undertaking first.
UNDERTAKING_VERSION_MISMATCH: The undertaking was updated. Please read the new version and accept it.
INVALID_CURSOR: This list changed. Please reload it.
NETWORK: You seem to be offline. Please check your connection and try again.
ITEM_NOT_FOUND: This post is no longer available.
TURNSTILE_FAILED: We could not check that this is a real phone. Please try again.
LIBRARY_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND: This library entry no longer exists.
LIBRARY_DUPLICATE: An entry with this kind and reference is already in the library.
TEMPLATE_EXISTS: A template with this key already exists.
TEMPLATE_REVIEW_REQUIRED: Review all four translations and tick “Translations reviewed” first.
PRECONDITION_FAILED: Someone else changed this just now. Please look at the latest version and try again.
TIMINGS_INVALID: Some times don’t fit together. Please check the times marked in red.
NOTIFY_QUOTA_EXCEEDED: Today’s notifications are used up. You can still save without notifying followers.
ACTIVATION_TIMINGS_REQUIRED: This masjid can be activated once all five jamaat times are set.
SPECIAL_DATE_NOT_FOUND: This special date was removed. Please go back to the list.
SPECIAL_DATE_INVALID: Please check the date and times: up to 5 different times, on a date within about a year.
RAMADAN_INVALID: Please check the Ramadan dates: the last day comes after the first, at most 30 days.
IMAGE_INVALID: This photo can't be used. Please choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo (iPhone: pick it from Photos).
ANNOUNCEMENT_INVALID: Something in this notice is not right. Please check the details and try again.
DUA_INVALID: Something in this dua request is not right. Please check the janaza time and try again.
EDIT_WINDOW_CLOSED: Posts can be changed for 24 hours after publishing. You can still delete this post.
ITEM_NOT_EDITABLE: This kind of post cannot be changed here.
PROFILE_INVALID: This change to the masjid profile is not possible. Please check it and try again.
ADHKAR_INVALID: This adhkar list is not possible: at most 30, each one once. Please check it and try again.
VOICE_INVALID: A voice note needs a short title. Please add one and try again.
AUDIO_INVALID: This file is not a voice recording the app can use. Please record again or choose another file.
AUDIO_TOO_LONG: Voice notes can be at most 10 minutes long.
RUQYAH_INVALID: A recording needs a short title and the tick that it is yours to share. Please check and try again.
RUQYAH_NOT_FOUND: This Ruqyah entry was removed. Please go back to the list.
RUQYAH_LIMIT_REACHED: The Ruqyah section already has 50 entries. Delete one to add another.
RUQYAH_ORDER_INVALID: The Ruqyah list changed meanwhile. Please open it again and reorder.
CONTACT_INVALID: Please tick that this person agreed, and check the WhatsApp number.
CONTACT_NOT_FOUND: This contact was removed. Please go back to the list.
CONTACT_LIMIT_REACHED: You can list up to 10 contacts. Remove one to add another.
PUSH_ENDPOINT_IN_USE: Notifications could not be turned on on this phone. Please try again.
PAYMENT_INVALID: Check the UPI ID and the payee name, then try again.
PAYMENT_UNCHANGED: These are already the payment details shown to everyone.
PAYMENT_OWNER_ONLY: Only an owner of the masjid can ask to change the UPI details.
PAYMENT_REQUEST_OPEN: A change is already waiting. You can ask again once it is decided.
PAYMENT_NOTICE_UNAVAILABLE: Activate the “Payment details updated” notice template first, so followers are told about the change.
PAYMENT_DETAILS_IN_TEXT: Please remove the UPI ID or payment link from the text. Followers pay only to the masjid's verified UPI details.
PAYMENT_NOT_FOUND: This payment request no longer exists.
PAYMENT_REQUESTER_REMOVED: The admin who asked no longer has access, so this request was stopped.
PAYMENT_NOT_OPEN: This request is already live or closed.
VIDEO_INVALID: Check the title and the audience, then try again.
INVALID_VIDEO_LINK: This is not a YouTube video link.
VIDEO_UNAVAILABLE: This video is private or can't be shown in other apps.
VIDEO_LOOKUP_FAILED: YouTube could not be reached. Try again in a minute.
ITEM_LOCKED: This notice was sent by the app and cannot be changed or deleted.
CAMPAIGN_INVALID: Check the title, the target (at least ₹1,000) and the dates, then try again.
CAMPAIGN_NO_PAYMENT: Set up your masjid's UPI first (Masjid Profile → UPI payment details).
CAMPAIGN_LIMIT_REACHED: You can run up to 3 donation drives at once. Mark one completed first.
CAMPAIGN_NOT_FOUND: This donation drive no longer exists.
CAMPAIGN_NOT_ACTIVE: This donation drive is already completed or closed.
CAMPAIGN_CLOSED: This donation drive has closed. The amount can no longer be changed.
CAMPAIGN_TARGET_LOWER: The target can only be raised, not lowered.
CHANDA_INVALID: Please check the week and the amount.
CHANDA_HIDDEN: Turn on “Show chanda to followers” before notifying them.
BENEFICIARY_INVALID: Please check the UPI ID, the name on the UPI account and the amount needed.
BENEFICIARY_NOT_FOUND: This person is no longer on the list.
BENEFICIARY_LIMIT_REACHED: You can list up to 100 people at a time. Close one to add another.
